title: CarrierAnswerResponse
description: Norvia's answer to a Carrier's answer sent to the Norvia Partner API (version 1). The result says which of the six answers it is; each comes with its own HTTP status, listed in the Partner API README.

messageId.description: Norvia's ID for this answer (the correlation ID). Quote it when asking Norvia about the answer.

recorded.description: HTTP 200. Norvia recorded the answer, or already had the same answer (repeated is then true). The booking is Confirmed or Rejected at Norvia.

decision.description: The decision Norvia holds for the booking.

repeated.description: True when the same answer was recorded before. Nothing was recorded again.

refusal.description: Norvia did not record the answer. BOOKING_NOT_OPEN (HTTP 409): Norvia no longer has the booking open, for example because it withdrew it while the Carrier was answering, or the booking already has a different answer. BOOKING_NOT_FOUND (HTTP 404): Norvia has no such booking. NOT_ALLOWED (HTTP 403): the booking isn't this Carrier's. INVALID (HTTP 400): the answer can't be used; text says why. NOT_RECEIVED (HTTP 502): Norvia could not take the answer in, so nothing was recorded; send it again.
